name: hints-updater
description: HTTP 103 Early Hints updater - captures origin responses and updates EdgeKV with Last-Modified tracking

scripts.build:namespace: bash -c ': "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"; perl -0pi -e "s/__EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__/$EDGEKV_NAMESPACE/g" built/*.js; if grep -rq __EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__ built; then echo "ERROR: __EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__ still present in built/ after substitution" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.package: npm run package:bundle && npm run package:vendor && npm run package:tarball
scripts.package:bundle: mkdir -p built && jq -n --arg version "$npm_package_version" --arg desc "$(jq -r .description package.json)" '{"edgeworker-version": $version, "description": $desc}' > built/bundle.json
scripts.package:vendor: bash -c 'tokens="vendor/edgekv_tokens.${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}.js"; [ -f "$tokens" ] || { echo "ERROR: $tokens not found - run npm run generate-edgekv-token for this namespace" >&2; exit 1; }; cp vendor/edgekv.js built/ && cp "$tokens" built/edgekv_tokens.js'
scripts.package:tarball: mkdir -p dist && cd built && tar czf ../dist/hints-updater_$npm_package_version.tgz *
scripts.check-edgekv-token: bash -c 'ns="${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"; ew="${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"; f="vendor/edgekv_tokens.$ns.js"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "ERROR: $f not found - run npm run generate-edgekv-token" >&2; exit 1; }; name="$(sed -nE "s/.*\"name\" *: *\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/p" "$f" | head -1)"; ref="$(sed -nE "s/.*\"reference\" *: *\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/p" "$f" | head -1)"; [ -n "$name" ] && [ -n "$ref" ] || { echo "ERROR: could not read token name/reference from $f" >&2; exit 1; }; args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); tok=$(akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" --jsonout download token "$name" 2>/dev/null | jq -c ".data.token // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$tok" ] || { echo "ERROR: EdgeKV token \"$name\" (from $f) not found on this account" >&2; exit 1; }; status=$(jq -r ".tokenActivationStatus" <<< "$tok"); [ "$status" = COMPLETE ] || { echo "ERROR: EdgeKV token \"$name\" activation status is $status - wait until it is COMPLETE (check: akamai edgekv list tokens), then retry" >&2; exit 1; }; [ "$(jq -r ".uuid" <<< "$tok")" = "$ref" ] || { echo "ERROR: reference in $f does not match token \"$name\" - regenerate the token file" >&2; exit 1; }; jq -e --arg e "$ew" ".restrictToEdgeWorkerIds | index(\$e)" <<< "$tok" > /dev/null || { echo "ERROR: EdgeKV token \"$name\" is not valid for EdgeWorker $ew (valid for: $(jq -r ".restrictToEdgeWorkerIds | join(\",\")" <<< "$tok"))" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "OK: EdgeKV token \"$name\" is COMPLETE and valid for EdgeWorker $ew"'
scripts.upload: npm run check-edgekv-token && bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" upload "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" --bundle dist/hints-updater_$npm_package_version.tgz'
scripts.activate:staging: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" staging $npm_package_version'
scripts.activate:production: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" production $npm_package_version'
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run package && npm run upload && npm run activate:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run package && npm run upload && npm run activate:production
scripts.generate-token: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" auth --expiry 600 "${EW_HOSTNAME:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" --jsonout | jq -r .msg'
scripts.list-contracts: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" li-contracts --jsonout'
scripts.list-groups: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" lg'
scripts.list-tiers: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" li-restiers'
scripts.check-edgekv-tier: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); tier="$npm_package_config_tier"; [ "$tier" -ge 200 ] 2>/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: config.tier is \"$tier\" but EdgeKV requires resource tier 200 or higher" >&2; exit 1; }; contracts=$(akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" li-contracts --jsonout 2>/dev/null | jq -r ".data[].ContractIds // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$contracts" ] || { echo "ERROR: could not list contracts for this account - check .edgerc section / account switch key" >&2; exit 1; }; for c in $contracts; do if akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" li-restiers --contractId "$c" --jsonout 2>/dev/null | jq -e --argjson t "$tier" "any(.data[]; .resourceTierId == \$t)" >/dev/null; then echo "OK: resource tier $tier (required for EdgeKV) is available on contract $c"; exit 0; fi; done; echo "ERROR: resource tier $tier is not available on any contract ($(echo $contracts)) - EdgeKV needs it: enable it on the contract (see npm run list-tiers)" >&2; exit 1'
scripts.create-id: npm run check-edgekv-tier && bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" create-id "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" --resourceTierId "$npm_package_config_tier" "$npm_package_config_ew_name-${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"'
scripts.rename-id: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" update-id "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" "$npm_package_config_ew_name-${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"'
scripts.list-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" list ns staging "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"'
scripts.list-edgekv-ns-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" list ns production "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"'
scripts.create-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns staging "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" --retention "${EDGEKV_RETENTION:-0}" --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"'
scripts.create-edgekv-ns-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns production "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}" --retention "${EDGEKV_RETENTION:-0}" --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"'
scripts.generate-edgekv-token: bash -c 'ns="${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"; : "${HINTS_UPDATER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"; expiry=(); [ -n "$EXPIRY" ] && expiry+=(--expiry="$EXPIRY"); token_file="./vendor/edgekv_tokens.$ns.js"; perms="${EDGEKV_TOKEN_PERMS:-rw}"; name="${EDGEKV_TOKEN_NAME:-hints-$perms-$ns}"; [ ${#name} -le 32 ] || { echo "ERROR: token name \"$name\" is ${#name} chars; EdgeKV allows max 32 - set a shorter EDGEKV_TOKEN_NAME" >&2; exit 1; }; tmp=$(mktemp -d); args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.<env>.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); if akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create token "$name" --save_path="$tmp" --staging=allow --production=allow --ewids="$HINTS_UPDATER_EWID" --namespace="$ns"+"$perms" "${expiry[@]}" && perl -0pi -e "s/\"$ns\"\s*:/\"namespace-$ns\" :/" "$tmp/edgekv_tokens.js" && mv "$tmp/edgekv_tokens.js" "$token_file"; then echo "Saved $token_file"; echo "NOTE: new tokens take a few minutes to activate. upload/deploy will refuse until the token is COMPLETE - check with: npm run check-edgekv-token"; rc=0; else echo "ERROR: token not saved; existing $token_file left untouched" >&2; rc=1; fi; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc'
